metadata.title: Clicked like I was hunting shadows and somehow caught 1 unlucky soul? Valorant logic is wild
metadata.description:
Mashing buttons like a confused chicken on a caffeine rush.
Enemy probably wondering if I’m a hacker or just lucky.
Did NOT deserve this accidental win but I’ll take the chaos!
If your aim’s a glorious mess, this one’s for you.

Tap if your aim is more accident than skill!

#valorant #gamingfails #luckshot #funnygaming #shorts
